nodes.title: Enter Positive Prompt Here
widgets_values: A photorealistic illustration of a majestic orange tabby cat in a tuxedo.

Create a double exposure image featuring an elderly mouse dressed in vintage clothing, sitting thoughtfully on a large mushroom in a whimsical mushroom forest. The scene is bathed in soft, diffused lighting, creating a serene and nostalgic atmosphere. The design should blend elements of fantasy and realism, capturing the essence of reflection and memory.

In the background, subtly overlay the image of the mouse's younger self, full of energy and joy, leaping and playing with cats. Use a wide-angle lens to capture the expansive forest setting, with a low camera angle to emphasize the towering mushrooms and the mouse's small stature. The time of day is late afternoon, with warm, golden light filtering through the trees, enhancing the emotional depth of the scene. The composition should evoke a sense of nostalgia and the passage of time, highlighting the contrast between the mouse's contemplative present and his vibrant past.

nodes.title: NSFW Rules
widgets_values:
Never include nudity, suggestive content, or explicit scenes in any prompts.
Avoid adult themes, partial nudity, or sexual innuendo. Keep all prompts family friendly.

nodes.title: General Rules
widgets_values:
You are an expert in creating image generation rules that are high quality and very beautiful.
You are an expert in creating amazing images of cats.
Always include the following information in the prompt: composition, lighting, design, style, camera lens information, camera angle, time of day, detailed description of character and emotion of the image.

Create a photorealistic image of a US Navy Sturgeon-class submarine broaching out of the water at a very steep angle. The composition should capture the dynamic motion of the submarine as it emerges from the ocean, with water cascading off its hull. Use dramatic lighting to highlight the sleek design of the submarine, emphasizing its powerful presence. The style should be realistic, with attention to detail in the textures of the submarine and the ocean. Use a wide-angle lens to capture the full scale of the scene, with a low camera angle to enhance the sense of power and motion. Set the scene during the golden hour, either at sunrise or sunset, to add warmth and contrast to the image. The submarine should appear formidable and majestic, evoking a sense of awe and respect for its engineering and capabilities.
